title: SG-5.3 · Round service wired into admin routes and scheduler
summary: Admin round routes sit behind the admin token and the scheduler starts in main
description: Context: backend/internal/server/server.go already builds round.Service (newRoundService), adapts it with roundAdmin and roundDefaults, and mounts the five admin round routes under admin.Middleware. cmd/server/main.go already runs server.NewScheduler(cfg).Run(ctx). Desired behavior: this wiring is confirmed against the code and covered by passing route tests. Expected result: go test ./internal/server passes. Why: sub-goal SG-5.3 must be met without duplicating work that exists.
acceptance_criteria: Given a token-less request, when any admin round route is called, then the response is 401
Given Bearer token and an existing round, when each admin round route is called, then the response is not 404
Given main starts, when the server runs, then the scheduler Run loop is started on the shared context
definition_of_done: Admin round routes mounted behind token middleware
